units.source_text: 母亲一只脚跪倒在泥田里，一边仰望着女儿，一边对旁边田里的人说：

en.t: The mother knelt with one foot in the muddy field, looked up at her daughter, and said to the people in the neighboring field:

units.source_text: “我呀，这回又有了个可怕的丈夫。

en.t: "As for me, this time I have ended up with another dreadful husband.

units.source_text: 相形之下，还是前头的丈夫更温和些。”

en.t: By comparison, my previous husband was still the gentler one."

units.source_text: 说着像大姑娘似的，两颊飞起了红潮。

en.t: As she said this, her cheeks flushed red like those of a grown young girl.
